description: Run one consolidation pass now (all configured banks, or one bank). Deterministic near-duplicate dedup, plus the optional LLM tiers when enabled (reorder judge; semantic merge/supersede of new memories, each with a reason), applied strictly through memory::supersede; pinned memories are untouchable. dry_run plans without writing.

bank.description: Consolidate only this bank (must be in the configured allowlist, when one is set).

dry_run.description: Override the configured dry_run for this call.

capped.description: Work left behind by the per-run cap; the next pass picks it up.

errors.description: Real failures (reads, writes). Any error keeps the pass due.

llm_merged.description: Reorder groups merged after the LLM judge confirmed equivalence.

notes.description: Soft skips (an optional tier unavailable, a sibling too old) — telemetry only: they never block the checkpoint, so an absent router cannot re-run the whole pass on every heartbeat.

promoted.description: Standing-instruction lines the judge promoted into the bank's `learned` rule.

reinforced.description: Winner reinforcements applied (one per absorbed duplicate).

semantic.description: Semantic-tier decisions (applied, or planned on dry runs), each with the judge's reason.

semantic_failed.description: New memories the judge could not decide even alone (a poison input); skipped past the cursor so they cannot wedge the tier.

semantic_rejected.description: Judge actions dropped by validation (unknown alias, pinned target, wrong direction, a lost number, ...).

superseded.description: Supersedes actually applied (0 on dry runs).

PlannedGroup.description: One planned merge: `losers` retire in favor of `winner`.

loser_texts.description: Texts of the losers, aligned with `loser_ids` (the judge tier and human review need the words, not just ids).

report_only.description: True = surfaced for review only (token-set match: same words, different order — potentially different meaning). Never written automatically.

skipped_pinned.description: Losers left alone because they are pinned (pinned is untouchable).

SemanticAction.description: One semantic-tier decision as reported (and kept in `last_report`).

applied.description: False on dry runs. Actions dropped by the pre-write freshness check are not listed here; they count in `semantic_rejected` with a note.

checkpointed.description: The pass completed cleanly AND its last-run checkpoint persisted. False = the schedule will retry the pass next check.

superseded.description: Total supersedes applied across banks this pass.
